content.text: What Does a Criminal Defense Lawyer Do? Do I Need One? Having the right criminal defense lawyer can make all the difference in your case. Experienced criminal defense attorneys know the law and how to navigate the very complex and broken justice system. Criminal defense lawyers are responsible for advocating for clients, investigating the case and protecting their client’s rights. Criminal defense lawyers also have to navigate complex California laws. Therefore, if you are facing criminal charges, it is important to speak with a qualified criminal defense lawyer as soon as possible. What is a Criminal Defense Lawyer? A criminal defense lawyer is a lawyer who specializes in defending individuals who have been accused of a crime. Criminal defense lawyers are responsible for investigating the case, interviewing witnesses, and gathering evidence to build a strong defense for their clients. They also must navigate complex California laws and ensure their client’s rights are protected throughout the legal process. What Makes a Good Criminal Defense Lawyer? There are a few qualities that make an excellent criminal defense lawyer. First, they should have experience handling similar cases in the past. If a criminal defense attorney has no trial experience, then they have no experience. To truly understand the law and the criminal system, a good lawyer must try criminal cases in front of a jury. Second, they should be familiar with the California laws that apply to your case. The more experience your attorney has, the more familiarity they have with the rules and defenses. Third, they should be able to build a strong defense and present it in a way that is easy for the jury to understand. But, again, this comes from trial experience. Finally, they should be passionate about protecting their client’s rights and fighting for a fair outcome. If you feel like your lawyer doesn’t care about you – they probably don’t. You should feel like your lawyer is on your side. Do Criminal Lawyers Have to Defend the Guilty? First, all people are presumed innocent under the law until a jury finds them guilty or they plead guilty. All lawyers are ethically obligated to provide a vigorous defense for their clients regardless of whether they believe them to be guilty or innocent. It is the criminal defense lawyer’s job to ensure that their client receives a fair trial and that their rights or protected. Just because you did “something” does not mean you are guilty of the crime you are being charged with. The law is complex. That is why having an experienced criminal defense attorney can make all the difference in your case. Do Criminal Lawyers Investigate? Criminal defense lawyers are responsible for investigating the case and gathering evidence to build a strong defense for their clients when preparing for trial. This includes interviewing witnesses, reviewing police reports, and examining physical evidence. Criminal defense lawyers also have to navigate complex California laws. Therefore, if you are facing criminal charges, it is important to speak with a qualified criminal defense lawyer as soon as possible. Please don’t wait until it’s too late.
